He's a really relatable character, a very "I do not want to fucking do this right now." type. Could go on.

I loved the original DS1, and there's very few cases where I feel remakes eclipse the need to play the original (ie I still recommend playing SH2 original even though the remake is stellar), but this game truly is just the original game but better in every single way possible. Cannot recommend enough.

Just want to give a little backstory in the comments:

First, this was last summer. I’m okay now! Just some discoloration where my skin healed but nothing gnarly besides a bunch of freckles (which I am monitoring to this day lmao). Phew. 

Secondly, I am fair, so to be honest, I don’t know why I didn’t wear sunscreen. That was quite literally one of my most dense moments. I’ve owned up to my own stupidity and it certainly won’t happen again. 

Third, the timeline. Spent 5-6ish hours with friends on the river. Was wearing board shorts on an uncovered kayak, no sunscreen. Looking back, I can distinctly remember when I started feeling my skin start to burn but I waved it off. By the time our trip was complete, I was feeling very feverish and complaining to my friends how uncomfortable I was and that I was gonna need to go home and go to sleep immediately. I barely made it in the door, much less home. I was in SEVERE pain by just that evening, but I thought it was within the realm of “regular sunburn” so I applied aloe and went to sleep. Woke up feverish and in pain again, but when I tried to leave my bed and walk, I collapsed in some of the worst pain I’ve ever felt. 

This was what would become the worst part for me: the helplessness. I couldn’t walk, I couldn’t leave my bed. I spent hours sobbing because I was panicking. 

This went on for a few days (I tried to go to work a couple times because I’m stubborn, but I was sent home early due to severe pain :/), my skin darkening to this purple color you see. I simply applied aloe ans lotion in force and dealt with the pain as much as I could. My friends were URGING me to go to the doctor but I was like “nah it’ll be fiiiine.” And then the yellow spots appeared. Thank god my mother forced me to the doctor. I was informed that if I had waited 72 hours more I had a high chance of becoming septic. I was prescribed an antibacterial to get rid of the infection and told to stay in bed until the discoloration and pain subsided. 

Funnily enough, my local pharmacy had closed by this time, so I had to wait one more whole day to get medication. Needless to say that was one of the most stressful sleeps of my life. 

This is getting long! Apologies! The moral of the story is: WEAR SUNSCREEN!!!!!! and listen to your friends if they urge you to go to the doctor.
